Nora: Quick midweek async — short status snapshot (what I did / blockers / today)
Nora: Done: final pass on the embed-cache spec and landed edits to the doc https://docs.redwood.ai/embed-cache-spec (linked section: rollout + metrics)
Nora: Blocker: waiting on API contract signoff for routing fallback from @Sam — need a thumbs by EOD :pray:
Sam: On it. Will scan the contract and leave comments in the doc by EOD. quick q: are we still preferring smaller quantized variants for low-cost tier?
Nora: Yes — Optimize recommended gguf quantized variants for the low-cost path, same surface area but different model weights. I added a note in the decisions section.
Emily: FYI I merged the autoscaler tweaks into staging (infra PR). Expect brief pod churn as thresholds settle — watching logs.
Raj: Ping: PR review request -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/472 (batcher tweak). @Emily can you do a quick sanity check on the concurrency change? :eyes:
Emily: I can after lunch, should be a quick pass.
CiBot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for branch feature/embed-cache (build #1243) — smoke tests queued.
Sam: Blocker: I still need tail latency numbers from eng-runtime for 512-token workloads to finalize SLOs. @Raj, can you surface approximate 95th/99th?
Raj: Posting quick numbers from the perf harness (pre-canary):
Raj: - p4d 8x (512 tokens): 95th ~ 78ms, 99th ~ 180ms
Raj: - p3dn (512 tokens): 95th ~ 120ms, 99th ~ 260ms
Raj: Note: these runs had continuous-batching disabled for the canary profile — production tuning will improve numbers.
Nora: Good enough for the rollout plan. Action: I'll make p4d the primary and p3 fallback in the routing matrix.
Sam: Please add an automatic rollback trigger on error rate > 1% and tail latency spike > 2x baseline. @Nora
Nora: Done — added triggers to the rollout doc and rollout config snippet.
Emily: Small ask: I need a review on the metrics naming doc before we onboard dashboards (https://docs.redwood.ai/metrics/naming). Can someone review by tomorrow morning?
Raj: Ack, will scan tonight.
Sam: LGTM on the outbound mapping change in PR 472 (left one nit).
Emily: Noted, will address the nit and push.
Nora: Thanks — if anyone hits a hard blocker for launch, ping #eng-oncall or DM me.
CiBot: deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed for canary build #1243 — all checks green.
Sam: Great, I'll merge the infra PR once CI finishes the final run.
Nora: Shipping window tentatively Thu 16:00 PT. Please be blockers-free by Thu 12:00 PT so we can do final checks.
Emily: I'll add a calendar block + reminder.
Raj: I'll keep an eye on latency dashboards and post any anomalies here.
Nora: Thanks team — end-of-thread update. :thumbsup:
